title: grindelia stricta subsp. blakei
intro: Grindelia stricta subsp. blakei, commonly known as California stickweed or gum plant, is a plant species in the sunflower family that is native to the western coast of North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the relief of allergy symptoms, anti-inflammatory effects, and the treatment of various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Grindelia stricta subsp. blakei are attributed to its ability to inhibit histamine release and its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which are likely due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones and triterpenoids.
